notes.text: foundations.mdx:16 copies literal HSL values for both --primary tokens; check.mjs pins rule sentences, not values, so they drift silently. Keep the blob links, drop the literals or label 'at time of writing'; blob links pin main so consider version-pinned links.

foundations.mdx:14,16 restates the pinned sentences in sentence case ('Indigo/violet', 'Site chrome') vs canonical lowercase, and says 'are black' vs canonical 'near-black'. Align wording with VISUAL-CONTRACT.md:60,66 for verbatim consistency.
foundations.mdx:6 disclaimer uses contributor jargon ('home pass', 'paints them', 'first paint') with no visitor referent. Reword in plain visitor language.

foundations.mdx:24 states 'Prose is 15px. Body copy is 14px' without the rule telling them apart (lives in VISUAL-CONTRACT.md:44-45); state 44x44 CSS px for controls/tabs/nav and note inline prose links are exempt; cite the H1 rule behind 'One docs title per page'.
foundations.mdx:44 says reduced motion 'removes displacement'; signature.md:62 also kills loops. Say 'removes displacement and loops' so the page is safe to follow alone.

Taxonomy nits: chips read as a 'high-value panel' kind in VISUAL-CONTRACT.md:66 but as a sibling accent home in signature.md:46; 'One action accent' (:59) vs two chrome action colors. Use one taxonomy (e.g. 'high-value surfaces') and scope L59 per view/surface.

Pinned verbatim duplication: signature.md:43-44 repeats the two chrome sentences for the same maintainer audience, enforced character-identical by check.mjs:232-242. Consider deleting the bullets (keep header + owner pointer) and asserting the signature references the owner instead.

check.mjs:1-24 header comment enumerates assertions 1-11 but omits the new chrome-rule pinning (and the pre-existing guide-section loop). Add header entries so newcomers know this script owns cross-file chrome-rule sync.

The guide-section contract (guideRequiredSections + foundations link/no-copy rules) is enforced in code but undocumented: PAGE-TEMPLATE.md covers path/frontmatter/snippets/slug order only. Add 2-3 lines so editors learn it before a CI failure.
signature.md:31 has the same broken ../apps/docs/VISUAL-CONTRACT.md pattern (pre-existing, not from this PR). Fix it in the same edit as the :41 blocker.
CI was pending at review start (changes queued, hygiene in_progress). Typecheck, lint, catalog:check, and header-spec execution are deferred to CI; automerge waits for green.
